files.description: Hospital admissions (260 rows): admission_id (whole number), age (years, whole number; about 5% empty), ward (cardiology, oncology, maternity, orthopedics or neurology; capital letters and spaces are inconsistent), stay_days (whole number; about 3% empty), charge (two decimals; about 5% empty).

task_text: Make a table of the charges indexed by admission_id (the ids exactly as in the file). Then renumber the admissions from 1 upward in file order, using NumPy array arithmetic on the ids, and add the new numbers as a column called new_number. `result` should be the table indexed by admission_id with the columns charge and new_number.
intended_computation: Return 260 rows in file order: index = admission_id as in the file (600-859), charge unchanged, new_number = 1..260.

predicted_direction.reason: on 2.x the index is built on the same NumPy array, so renumbering the array also renumbers the index

notes: Drafted 2026-11-11 in package TASKS_M1; task text, card, naive solution, reference and predicted direction were prepared there.
